remarks: Discover this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 1.1-bath home, ideally situated near the park, library, train, and village. The brand-new kitchen features stainless steel appliances, an island, and elegant quartz countertops, seamlessly flowing into the dining room with built-ins. The inviting living room boasts hardwood floors and a wood-burning fireplace, while a sunlit office provides the perfect work-from-home space. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms, including a primary with built-ins, and a stylishly renovated bathroom with a tub-shower combination. Additional storage is available in the walk-up attic and lower level. New washer & dryer located in lower level. Enjoy outdoor entertaining on the backyard patio within the fenced yard. Located in the International School of Dundee district.
